review:
A 25-line moon heist where moon spiders keep things lively by swapping random symbols for wilds.

Two bonus symbols start Moon Respin, where moons with multipliers up to 20x hold in place, joined by a Collector (grabs all moon values), a Booster (raises them) and a Cleaner. Free spins are very rare – about once every 600 spins – so the respin is the real event. Medium-low volatility, 5,000x max and 97% RTP.
pros: Excellent 97.00% RTP – among the highest published
Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
cons: Bonus is rare (about 1 in 600 spins on average)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
